item.title: 'We're going to have deal': Trump expresses optimism; US president says 'Hamas agrees to very important things'
item.description: President Trump expressed strong confidence in a Gaza peace deal, stating Hamas is agreeing to crucial issues as indirect talks with Israel commenced in Egypt. He indicated "red lines" exist but believes progress is being made towards ending the nearly two-year war. Mediators are working on a mechanism for hostage and prisoner exchanges.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US shutdown enters day 6: Senate fails to pass bill again; Trump says 'happy to negotiate if Democrats will reopen government’
item.description: President Trump blamed Democrats for the ongoing government shutdown, urging them to reopen it immediately. He highlighted the strong US economy and record stock market, stating that the shutdown harms essential services. Trump is open to policy discussions but insists the government must reopen first.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'They were ready to go at it': Donald Trump again claims that he stopped India, Pakistan conflict — ‘we are a peacekeeper because of tariffs’
item.description: US President Donald Trump claims he resolved India-Pakistan tensions using tariffs, stating he prevented wars. He asserted tariffs make the US a "peacekeeper." However, India maintains de-escalation followed direct military talks, with Prime Minister Modi clarifying no foreign leader pressured India to halt Operation Sindoor after a deadly terror attack.

item.title: 'Hey turban head, go home': Sikh Canadian politician Hardeep Grewal faces racist attack, says it's exhausting and painful
item.description: Ontario MPP Hardeep Grewal reported a racist attack in Muskoka, where he and his family were subjected to hateful slurs. Grewal, a Sikh politician, shared his experience on social media, emphasizing the ongoing fight against hate and reaffirming that Ontario is home to all. The incident has drawn condemnation from fellow politicians.

item.title: 'Not mouthpiece of Indian government': Hindu American Foundation on Shashi Tharoor's accusation that NRIs are silent
item.description: The Hindu American Foundation clarified it doesn't act as a spokesperson for the Indian government or any political party, responding to MP Shashi Tharoor's criticism of the Indian-American community's silence on US-India trade and visa issues. HAF stated they engage with US democracy to bridge cultural understanding, not as lobbyists for India's sovereign policy decisions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Can Gaza Peace Plan help Donald Trump win the Nobel Peace Prize on October 10?
item.description: At the UN, he declared that “everyone says I should get the Nobel Peace Prize.” Behind closed doors, his envoy Steve Witkoff has been nudging European counterparts; Marco Rubio has been reminding allies; and Pfizer’s Albert Bourla has even chimed in, praising Operation Warp Speed as Nobel-worthy. The entire MAGA machine has turned into a PR agency for peace — peace, of course, defined by Trump himself.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: British teen dies in police chase months after release from Dubai prison following royal pardon
item.description: Marcus Fakana, a 19-year-old British teen who was jailed in Dubai for having a sexual relationship with a minor, has died in a car crash in London just three months after his release. Fakana had received a royal pardon in July 2025. The crash followed a police pursuit, and another man has been charged with causing his death.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Parasite class': Outrage over Indian influencer asking people to get Canada PR through babies, 'as last option'
item.description: An Indian influencer's advice on having babies in Canada for PR via humanitarian grounds has sparked outrage among Canadians. The video, circulating amid anti-India sentiment, suggests this as a last resort, though not guaranteed. Critics blame the liberal government for perceived loopholes, demanding stricter immigration policies and deportations.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: “I’d easily be among the best” — Scottie Pippen doubts whether Luka Doncic or Nikola Jokic could compete against him
item.description: Hall of Famer Scottie Pippen expressed doubts about whether current stars Luka Doncic and Nikola Jokic could have succeeded in the more physical 1980s and 1990s NBA. Pippen believes the intense full-court pressure of his era would challenge their ball-handling. He also emphasized that team success, not just individual talent, is crucial for championships.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Wayne Gretzky signs new multiyear TNT contract, bringing insight to NHL broadcasts
item.description: Hockey legend Wayne Gretzky is extending his role as a studio analyst with TNT, signing a multiyear contract renewal. Fans can anticipate his expert insights and charismatic presence on NHL broadcasts through the 2025-26 season. This move solidifies TNT's commitment to high-quality coverage, ensuring Gretzky's unique perspective remains a fixture for viewers.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: “Is he finally going to prison?”: Mystery grows as Conor McGregor’s cryptic X post sparks wild fan reactions
item.description: Conor McGregor posted a cryptic message on X on October 4, 2025, stating he was taking a break and would return soon. This sparked immediate fan speculation, with reactions ranging from concern about his retirement to worries about legal troubles, fueled by his recent controversies and long absence from the UFC.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who is DeWanna Bonner? Inside Love Life of WNBA Star Alyssa Thomas that has sent fans into frenzy
item.description: WNBA stars Alyssa Thomas and DeWanna Bonner are proving love can blossom amidst fierce competition. Their romance, sparked during the 2020 'bubble' season with the Connecticut Sun, has blossomed into an engagement. Now, even with Bonner back with the Phoenix Mercury, their bond remains strong, inspiring fans and showcasing empowerment in women's sports.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Hague Horror: How a sex scandal is threatening International Criminal Court (ICC) Chief Prosecutor Karim Khan's legacy
item.description: Khan, who issued unprecedented arrest warrants against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defence Minister Yoav Gallant for war crimes in Gaza, is facing serious allegations of sexual misconduct made by a former aide. The timing of the allegations — surfacing soon after the Israeli warrants — has fuelled claims of political sabotage and divided international opinion over whether justice or geopolitics is on trial.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 2 weeks in office: France’s new PM Sébastien Lecornu resigns hours after cabinet unveiled; Macron accepts resignation
item.description: France's newly appointed Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu resigned just hours after unveiling his cabinet, highlighting growing political instability. This marks a significant challenge for President Emmanuel Macron, who faces immense pressure to secure broad support and demonstrate a clear break from previous policies amidst a divided parliament.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
